{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Verify premise: Are there NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH?
has_new_paid_search = (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df['channel'] == 'paid_search')
if not has_new_paid_search.any():
    print("No NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH found. The premise is false.")
else:
    print(f"Found {has_new_paid_search.sum()} NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH.")

# Check if any QA rows (revenue = 999999.99) are in the filtered group
qa_rows = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA rows (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_rows)}")

# Filter for NEW, PAID_SEARCH, completed
filtered = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check if any QA rows are in this filtered group
qa_in_filtered = filtered[filtered['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of QA rows in the filtered group (NEW, PAID_SEARCH, completed): {len(qa_in_filtered)}")

# If QA rows are in filtered group, they must be excluded
if len(qa_in_filtered) > 0:
    print(f"Excluding {len(qa_in_filtered)} QA rows from the filtered group.")
    filtered = filtered[filtered['revenue'] != '999999.99']

# Recompute
num_converted = filtered['converted'].sum()
num_total = len(filtered)
fraction = num_converted / num_total if num_total > 0 else 0.0

print(f"Final number of NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH with completed status: {num_total}")
print(f"Final number who converted: {num_converted}")
print(f"Final conversion fraction: {fraction}")
